note: Engineering implementation and production qualification are intentionally separate. No capability is PRODUCTION until immutable external real-workload evidence satisfies the qualification thresholds and the exact release SHA passes self-hosted verification, CodeQL, staged live verification and canonical post-promotion verification. Internal/synthetic browser corpora are regression evidence, not field validation.

capabilities.title: Bounded local Playwright capture to faultline.capture.v1
capabilities.evidence: Implemented caller-owned page capture with bounded DOM/CSS/diagnostics, secret-safe control handling, explicit external-dependency rejection and atomic import semantics.

capabilities.title: Sandboxed portable browser failure runtime
capabilities.evidence: Implemented DOM/property/attribute/existence/computed-style/runtime-error oracles, bounded actions, restrictive iframe/CSP containment and revision-guarded state. Browser containment is not VM isolation.

capabilities.title: Adaptive SAME_CAUSE causal stability
capabilities.evidence: Implemented full-oracle identity, hard rejection of jointly observed strong/supporting signal drift, three-run deterministic baseline probe, repeated candidate confirmation and 15/20 escalation for flaky baselines. Physical browser executions count against the trial budget.

capabilities.title: Hierarchical HTML/CSS/JavaScript reduction
capabilities.evidence: Implemented balanced HTML subtrees, CSS rules/declarations, parser-backed JavaScript statements/class members, pin/ancestor closure, SAME_CAUSE candidate acceptance and independent final confirmation.

capabilities.title: Bounded data/network/repository collection reduction
capabilities.evidence: Implemented deterministic collection reduction with protected keys, memoization, bounded parallel evaluation and explicit 1-minimal fixpoint over caller-supplied replayable units. Automatic arbitrary repository rewriting is not claimed.

capabilities.title: Caller-owned in-situ Playwright execution and interaction reduction
capabilities.evidence: Implemented reset-before-trial live execution, deterministic interaction recipes, adaptive SAME_CAUSE reduction and DOM/runtime/console/network/race/performance oracle families.

capabilities.title: Bounded browser-state and network capture/replay
capabilities.evidence: Implemented opt-in cookie/storage replay, default secret redaction, sensitive-header stripping, origin allowlists, body/entry budgets and strict unmatched-request blocking.

capabilities.title: Official Playwright trace provenance binding
capabilities.evidence: Implemented official Playwright tracing wrapper with SHA-256/byte binding, source/test provenance and post-capture tamper verification without parsing undocumented trace internals.

capabilities.title: Source-map evidence binding
capabilities.evidence: Implemented bounded v3 source-map validation, generated/map SHA-256 binding, source provenance and sanitized source-name metadata without copying sourcesContent.

capabilities.title: Runtime-bound reproducer evidence artifact
capabilities.evidence: Implemented immutable source/reset/fingerprint/metric binding plus optional environment state, network fixtures, trace and source-map evidence with an explicit secret-artifact confidentiality summary.

capabilities.title: Path-safe pinned one-command reproducer bundle
capabilities.evidence: Implemented Node 22 / Playwright 1.63 pinning, nested path-safe payloads, traversal rejection and complete SHA-256 ledger emitted after every generated payload.

capabilities.title: Customer-owned container/CI deployment
capabilities.evidence: Implemented Node 22 container packaging with exact locked Playwright 1.63 browser installation, non-root runtime and documented customer-owned trust/confidentiality boundary.
capabilities.nextEvidence: self-hosted branch verification + external organizational qualification

capabilities.title: Exact-source release integrity and provenance
capabilities.evidence: Build emits SHA-256 integrity.json, unsigned SLSA v1/in-toto provenance.json and release.json bindings. Live verifier checks exact source, provenance subject and every integrity-manifest asset before and after promotion.
capabilities.nextEvidence: green self-hosted qualification + staged/canonical deployment evidence; cryptographic attestation only when account eligibility is proven

capabilities.title: Revision-guarded WebMCP + window.faultline agent surface
capabilities.evidence: Canonical operations, revision guards, cancellation and structured evidence remain shared between human and agent callers.

capabilities.title: Immutable external-case production qualification
capabilities.evidence: Implemented immutable upstream identity checks, portable/live runners and a release gate requiring at least 30 independent cases, at least 10 accepted reductions, zero false equivalents, >=99% same-cause rate, >=90% supported-case reproduction and useful median reduction. Required external manifests/results are not yet present.

capabilities.title: Shared multi-tenant hostile-code execution service
capabilities.evidence: Explicit non-goal. Browser containment is not a process/VM boundary; mutually untrusted tenant execution requires independent workload identity, quotas, network/filesystem namespaces and ephemeral process/VM isolation.
